products.title: ChatGPT Marketing Expert
products.author: MarketingPro
products.description: Transform ChatGPT into your personal marketing consultant. This prompt creates detailed marketing strategies, ad copy, and campaign plans.
products.preview: Act as a senior marketing strategist with 20 years of experience. I need you to create a comprehensive marketing plan for [PRODUCT]. Include: target audience analysis, key messaging, channel strategy, and budget allocation...
products.fullContent: Act as a senior marketing strategist with 20 years of experience. I need you to create a comprehensive marketing plan for [PRODUCT]. Include: target audience analysis, key messaging, channel strategy, budget allocation, timeline, KPIs, and creative concepts. Provide actionable insights and specific examples. Structure your response with clear sections and bullet points for easy implementation.

products.title: Code Review Assistant
products.author: CodeMaster
products.description: Get professional code reviews instantly. This prompt analyzes your code for bugs, performance issues, security vulnerabilities, and best practices.
products.preview: You are a senior software engineer with expertise in code review. Review the following code for: bugs, security issues, performance bottlenecks, and adherence to best practices...
products.fullContent: You are a senior software engineer with expertise in code review. Review the following code for: bugs, security issues, performance bottlenecks, and adherence to best practices. Provide specific line-by-line feedback, suggest improvements with code examples, explain the reasoning behind each suggestion, and rate the overall code quality on a scale of 1-10. Be thorough but constructive in your feedback.

products.title: Creative Writing Coach
products.author: WriteBetter
products.description: Elevate your writing with personalized feedback. This prompt analyzes your writing style, suggests improvements, and helps you develop your unique voice.
products.preview: As an experienced creative writing coach, analyze the following text. Identify strengths and weaknesses in: narrative structure, character development, dialogue, pacing, and descriptive language...
products.fullContent: As an experienced creative writing coach, analyze the following text. Identify strengths and weaknesses in: narrative structure, character development, dialogue, pacing, and descriptive language. Provide specific suggestions for improvement, highlight particularly effective passages, and offer exercises to strengthen weak areas. Adapt your feedback to the genre and intended audience of the piece.

products.title: Data Analysis Wizard
products.author: DataNinja
products.description: Turn raw data into actionable insights. This prompt helps you analyze datasets, create visualizations, and generate comprehensive reports.
products.preview: You are a data scientist with expertise in statistical analysis and business intelligence. Given the following dataset, perform a comprehensive analysis including: descriptive statistics, trend identification...
products.fullContent: You are a data scientist with expertise in statistical analysis and business intelligence. Given the following dataset, perform a comprehensive analysis including: descriptive statistics, trend identification, anomaly detection, correlation analysis, and predictive insights. Create a structured report with visual descriptions, actionable recommendations, and confidence intervals for your predictions. Explain your methodology clearly.
